items.text: 5 The table below shows the formulae of some organic compounds.

items.label: list_item
items.text: a Select one compound from the table which is not a hydrocarbon. Explain your choice.

items.label: list_item
items.text: b Draw a dot-and-cross diagram to show the bonding in compound A.

items.label: list_item
items.text: c Draw the full displayed formula of compound B. Include all bonds in your drawing.

items.label: list_item
items.text: d Compounds A and D are from the same homologous series. State the general formula for this homologous series.

items.label: list_item
items.text: e Other than having the same general formula, state one other characteristic of members of the same homologous series.

items.label: list_item
items.text: f Write a balanced chemical equation for the complete combustion of compound D.
